from statemachine import State, StateChart, DataVar, HistoryState

class M(StateChart):
    class parent(State.Compound, data={'p': 1}):
        child = State(initial=True, data={'x': DataVar(default=1, type=int)})
        h = HistoryState(type='deep')
    outside = State()
    leave = parent.to(outside)
    back = outside.to(parent.h)
    def on_enter_child(self, state_data):
        assert state_data['p'] == 1
        assert state_data['x'] in (1, 5)

m = M()
m.set_state_data('child', 'x', 5)
m.leave()
m.back()
assert m.get_state_data('child')['x'] == 5
